question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

My son will __carry out my business__ in my absence.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"carry out"** means to perform or complete a task or activity. (कार्य करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The manager will **carry out **the evaluation process next week.
 
 
 
• **"Carry on" **refers to continuing with an activity or task. (जारी रखना)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the interruptions, she managed to **carry on** with her work.
 
 

Hence, in the context of the sentence, **"carry on"** is the most appropriate substitution for** "carry out" **when referring to continuing a business in someone’s absence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Carry at** (ले जाना): This is not a correct phrase in English.

 
 
• **Example:** This option is incorrect and does not fit in the sentence context.
 
 
 
• **Carry for** (के लिए ले जाना): This phrase is not commonly used and does not fit the context.
 
 
• **Example: **This option is incorrect and does not fit in the sentence context.
 
 
 
• **Carry in** (अंदर ले जाना): This phrase refers to bringing something inside.
 
 
• **Example:** He asked the movers to carry in the furniture.
